public_body: Fall River City Council Committee On Regulations
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The committee was not required to announce by name each member who participated remotely at its March 8, 2021 meeting, following OML 2020-168 and OML 2021-44. The matter was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to announce the name of each member who participated remotely in its March 8, 2021 meeting.
